dictionary.lore:
A fragment containing part of a memory. Its surface is etched in resonant crystal, allowing it to record the essence of a moment.
These hexagonal fragments are too perfect to be natural, suggesting an otherworldly origin. Indeed, who else but an artificial container for a Sliver could create such an unsettling physical reproduction of the abstract?
